description: This file defines a class QualificationsMenuConfigurator that implements menu configuration functionality for the Qualifications section in the OrangeHRM system. It uses traits and methods to override screen behaviors for the menu.

classes.name: QualificationsMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring the Qualifications menu within the HRM system, overriding screen actions for menu items related to qualifications.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default menu configuration for a given screen by replacing 'save' with 'view' in the URL and applying it to the current module's screen.
